title: Squared Marginal Difference
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ assign a real number to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Suppose $f$ is monotone under inclusion and takes only the values $0$ and $1$. For every element $i$ and every subset $S$, the square of $f(S\cup\{i\})-f(S\setminus\{i\})$ equals that difference.
